Restaurant's favorite review
Great food at Sapa
Jan 2026 • Friends
Went in on a whim with some friends to Tim's Sapa Kitchen. We were not disappointed. It's a pretty new establishment- about 2 years old - serving fusion European Vietnamese food. Presentation and taste are on point. The tasting menu portions are not tiny so each couple shared a tasting menu and a main dish which was sufficient for us.
Written January 15, 2026
Mr .Tim
Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We’re truly happy you decided to visit Tim’s Sapa Kitchen with your friends and that the experience exceeded your expectations.

It means a lot to hear that you enjoyed our fusion European–Vietnamese concept, as well as the presentation and flavors of the dishes. We also appreciate you mentioning the portion sizes — we want our tasting menu to feel refined but still satisfying and generous enough to share.

Thank you again for your support, and we hope to welcome you back soon for another memorable meal in Sapa!

Tim and Family
